analyst.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management delivered an excellent quarter - profit up 27%, AUM up 16%, and market share gains across overall, equity and SIP categories - continuing a genuine, capital-light growth story. The business quality is very high, but the current valuation (about 48 times trailing earnings) is near the top of where Indian asset managers have historically traded, so we see this as a quality name priced for a lot of continued success rather than a name offering a margin of safety.
